 Play Instrument (each instrument is a separate skill), Poetic
 Improvisation, Singing, Tale Telling, Ventriloquism This category includes
 skills which involve creative expression through the use of physical means
 or activity. It also includes those activities which are spontaneous or
 interactive, such as improvisation or duets. The nature of this category

@@ Acting
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for simulating actions or reactions of others,
 as often used in drama performances, devising identities, etc. This skill
 may be used to impersonate others, hide one’s own reactions from others. It
 may be used anytime character wishes to behave or appear in a manner other
 than normal and natural to him under any given circumstances. Unfamiliar
 with nature of subject: -30
 7+ ranks in spoken language: +10

@stat: Ag
@description:

 circumstances in which complex and/or footwork is necessary (e.g.,
 negotiating a pattern on the performing certain Magical Rituals, etc.).
 With: -10

 imitate a particular action (i.e., a movement not requiring a maneuver).
 Simple: 0

@@ Play Instrument
@stat: Ag
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for using a specific instrument, such as flute,
 drum, lute, etc. It may also be used to recognize musical patterns or
 rhythms, notes, etc. Note that separate opment is required for skill with
 each instrument.
